subject: Vendor activation: evidence request and PO steps for Vertex Secure
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@vertexsecure.com>
Cc: contracts@vertexsecure.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor activation: evidence request and PO steps for Vertex Secure

Hi Samir --

Great to have Vertex Secure moving into onboarding. To get the PO issued and accounts payable routing started we need the following items from you: 

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as Additional Insured and showing waiver of subrogation where available.
- Endorsement that specifically lists: Redwood Inference LLC, 450 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105 as Additional Insured.
- Policy limits confirmation: General Liability $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate, Auto Liability $1M, and Cyber Liability details (limits + retroactive date). If you have a coverage matrix, please include it.
- Completed vendor onboarding form (I attach our PDF) and W-9 (for US entities).

If you can provide the COI and W-9 by EOD Tue (PST) we can push the PO through and confirm a target activation date of Apr 21. If there are endorsement issues, flag them and we can loop legal.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form_2027.pdf (fillable)

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

--

Hi Alex,

Thanks — attaching what we have now.

Attached: VertexSecure_COI_2027-04.pdf, VertexSecure_W9_2027.pdf

A quick note on endorsements: our insurer is able to add Redwood as Additional Insured but they are pushing back on waiver of subrogation language for subcontractor-level services. We can provide a CG 20 10/11 endorsement naming Redwood Inference and an evidence letter from the broker clarifying cyber retro dates.

Do you need the endorsement verbatim for the certificate, or is the CG 20 endorsement + broker letter acceptable? If not, we can route to our broker/legal and request the specific policy language but it may take 3-5 business days.

Samir Patel

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor activation: evidence request and PO steps for Vertex Secure

Alex —

Thanks for forwarding Samir's note. Quick legal/proc review: the CG 20 endorsement is acceptable for Additional Insured in many cases, but we need to ensure the endorsement is broad enough to cover "ongoing and completed operations" depending on the scope of services. Also need explicit cyber limits and retroactive date in writing because we treat cyber coverage as a hard requirement for this account.

Ask to Vendor: please request the insurer include Redwood Inference as Additional Insured with CG 20 10/11 (or equivalent wording) that covers ongoing/completed ops. If waiver of subrogation is refused, we can accept with a note, but need a broker letter confirming limitation. Also ask for the cyber policy declarations page or a broker letter stating the limit and retroactive date.

If vendor pushes back on timing, we can put PO on conditional hold with a conditional-PO comment: "Activation contingent on receipt of Additional Insured endorsement and cyber evidence."

Rishi — FYI in case you want to draft a short conditional PO clause.

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Samir —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the COI/W-9. We reviewed with procurement/legal and the path below will work to keep timelines tight: 

- Provide the CG 20 10/11 endorsement naming Redwood Inference, showing ongoing and completed operations coverage.
- If waiver of subrogation is not available, include a broker letter stating that limitation.
- Provide cyber policy declarations page or broker letter with limit and retroactive date.

Once we have the endorsement and the cyber evidence we will issue a conditional PO with the following note: "Activation dependent on receipt of Additional Insured endorsement and cyber evidence; vendor may be activated for non-production support pending final paperwork."

Next steps:
1) Please upload the final PDF COI + endorsement and cyber evidence to the contracts inbox (contracts@vertexsecure.com) or reply-all with attachments.
2) I'll route the conditional PO for signature and AP setup — expected 48 hours from receipt.

If you need our exact wording for the endorsement, here's the line the insurer can include on the endorsement: 
"Redwood Inference LLC, 450 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105 is named as Additional Insured with respect to liability arising out of the operations performed by the named insured. Coverage is granted for both ongoing and completed operations."

Thanks — looking forward to getting you activated.

Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
